scope.title: Curated TVC Ashby Corpus
rules: Peer-reviewed primary research only in the main plot.
Physical thrust vectoring must be central to the vehicle, not merely a transferable method.
Near-exact coaxial/single-propulsion two-axis systems are retained regardless of evidence level.
Only a small comparator set of alternate servo-vectoring architectures is retained.
Reviews, standalone preprints, generic vehicles and method-only papers are excluded from the main plot.
Neural-Fly and residual RL are retained separately as method inspiration.

main.Title: Design, Optimal Guidance and Control of a Low-cost Re-usable Electric Model Rocket
main.Architecture: Single electric propulsion unit with 2-axis TVC
main.Project Relevance: Direct low-cost electric rocket-like GNC benchmark
main.Evidence Note: All computation reported onboard; platform cost below USD 1000.

main.Title: Optimal Thrust Vector Control of an Electric Small-Scale Rocket Prototype
main.Project Relevance: Direct benchmark for integrated optimal GNC
main.Evidence Note: Guidance and tracking solved online on embedded hardware.

main.Title: Design, Development, and Flight Testing of a Tube-Launched Coaxial-Rotor Based Micro Air Vehicle
main.Venue: International Journal of Micro Air Vehicles
main.Architecture: Coaxial rotors with pitch/roll thrust vectoring
main.Vectoring: Pitch/roll thrust vectoring; differential RPM yaw
main.Project Relevance: Exact mechanism family without rocket-testbed framing
main.Evidence Note: Important example of architecture-first rather than rocket-first literature.

main.Title: Development of a Tube-Launched Tail-Sitter Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
main.Venue: International Journal of Micro Air Vehicles
main.Architecture: Single coaxial propulsion unit on a two-axis gimbal; tail-sitter airframe
main.Vectoring: Two-axis gimbal, ±30°; differential rotor RPM for yaw
main.Control Method: Cascaded attitude/rate PID on custom autopilot
main.Key Metrics: 946 g vehicle; about 20 N maximum static thrust; indoor/outdoor hover and transition flight
main.Project Relevance: Near-exact propulsion and gimbal architecture with unusually detailed full-text hardware evidence.
main.Evidence Note: Peer-reviewed journal paper; earlier conference version noted by authors.

main.Title: Design, Modeling, and Control of a Coaxial Drone
main.Architecture: Two contra-rotating rotors with serial dual-axis servo rotation
main.Vectoring: Independent dual-axis rotation of the coaxial propulsion assembly
main.Control Method: Six-DOF nonlinear model and nonlinear control allocation with damping injection
main.Functional Scope: Position and yaw stabilization with maneuvering trajectory
main.Key Metrics: Numerical simulations and physical experiments reported in IEEE T-RO
main.Project Relevance: One of the closest peer-reviewed architecture matches and missing from the original corpus.
main.Evidence Note: Publisher DOI and author-hosted accepted PDF located.

main.Title: System Identification of a Thrust-Vectoring, Coaxial-Rotor-Based Gun-Launched Micro Air Vehicle in Hovering Flight
main.Venue: International Journal of Micro Air Vehicles
main.Architecture: Coaxial rotors with pitch/roll thrust vectoring
main.Vectoring: Pitch/roll thrust vectoring; differential RPM yaw
main.Key Metrics: Mode decoupling, eigenvalues and damping terms
main.Project Relevance: Direct evidence that system identification itself is not an empty field
main.Evidence Note: Longitudinal and lateral modes were nearly identical due to axisymmetry.

main.Title: Dynamics Modeling and Nonlinear Attitude Controller Design for a Rocket-Type Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
main.Control Method: LMI-based robust PID with nonlinear allocation
main.Project Relevance: Exact architecture but weak experimental evidence
main.Evidence Note: Do not plot as free-flight evidence without full-text confirmation.

main.Title: Modeling, Control Stabilization and Parameter Identification of a Thrust Vectoring Rocket-Type Aerial Robot
main.Architecture: Gimbal-based coaxial rotor system with two servos
main.Vectoring: Two-axis servo gimbal; differential coaxial torque
main.Control Method: Filtering-operator least squares with PSO tuning; PD stabilization
main.Functional Scope: Attitude and altitude stabilization for identification
main.Key Metrics: Noisy-measurement nonlinear parameter identification demonstrated numerically
main.Project Relevance: Exact architecture; useful for model identification, but it is simulation evidence only.

main.Title: Uniaxial Attitude Control of Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle with Thrust Vectoring under Model Variations by Deep Reinforcement Learning and Domain Randomization
main.Architecture: Two EDFs with synchronized vectoring on one-axis rig
main.Vehicle Form: EDF thrust-vector UAV on rotational rig
main.Control Method: PPO policy with LSTM and domain randomization
main.Key Metrics: Success within randomization range; failure outside range
main.Project Relevance: Closest hardware RL evidence, but only one rotational axis
main.Evidence Note: Pixhawk operated at 200 Hz; neural controller at 50 Hz; ±25° vector range.

main.Title: Fixed-Time Convergence Attitude Control for a Tilt Trirotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Based on Reinforcement Learning
main.Architecture: Tilt trirotor on limited-motion ball joint
main.Control Method: Fixed-time robust attitude control with RL
main.Project Relevance: Additional evidence that RL on TVC hardware is not wholly absent
main.Evidence Note: Rig allows free yaw and limited roll/pitch, not free flight.

main.Title: Nonlinear Modeling and Energy-Based Flight Control of a Coaxial VTOL UAV with Independent Thrust Vectoring for Autonomous Landing Maneuvers
main.Architecture: Coaxial VTOL with independently tilting propulsion units
main.Vectoring: Independent propulsion tilt with nonlinear allocation
main.Control Method: Quaternion IDA-PBC and nonlinear control allocation
main.Key Metrics: Three-dimensional numerical hover, cruise, transition and landing studies
main.Project Relevance: Close coaxial TVC comparator; propulsion topology is not the same single gimballed unit.
main.Evidence Note: Peer-reviewed open-access journal article published July 2026.

main.Title: Servo Integrated Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for Overactuated Tiltable-Quadrotors
main.Key Metrics: Rapid, robust and smooth pose tracking
main.Project Relevance: Shows actuator dynamics in advanced TVC control is not generally novel
main.Evidence Note: Servo integration was reported as important for optimizer convergence.

main.Title: Learning to Fly Omnidirectional Micro Aerial Vehicles with an End-To-End Control Network
main.Key Metrics: Compared with traditional controller under disturbances
main.Project Relevance: Early experimental end-to-end control for omnidirectional flight

inspiration.Title: Neural-Fly Enables Rapid Learning for Agile Flight in Strong Winds
inspiration.Key Metrics: Tracking error under winds up to 12.1 m/s
inspiration.Project Relevance: Alternative to end-to-end RL for disturbance adaptation
inspiration.Why outside main plot: Neural-Fly: offline learned residual basis plus online adaptive coefficients; useful for disturbance compensation, not a direct TVC competitor.

inspiration.Title: Residual Reinforcement Learning for Robot Control
inspiration.Project Relevance: Transferable hybrid architecture for safe staged learning
inspiration.Evidence Note: Include as method source, never as direct vehicle prior art.
inspiration.Why outside main plot: Residual RL: adds a learned correction to a fixed controller; useful as a controller architecture, not evidence on a TVC aircraft.
